pages.title: Copper Singularity
pages.text: A great heap of copper crushed into a single point. It has a reddish glow, and electricity seems to pass through it without resistance. It is heavy and smooth and smells faintly of pennies. Verdigris never forms on it; there is no surface left to oxidise.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Copper is cheap and plentiful, so it was easy to feed the Singularity Compactor enough of it. The ingots collapsed into a single conductive point.
